mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM SYS_Role r WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_Position_Role pr JOIN SYS_Position_User pu ON pu.P_ID = pr.P_ID WHERE pr.Role_ID = r.Role_ID AND pu.U_ID = #{uid} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_PositionP_Role ppr JOIN SYS_Position_User_P pup ON pup.PP_ID = ppr.PP_ID WHERE ppr.Role_ID = r.Role_ID AND pup.U_ID = #{uid} )
